title: Prefix caching and speculative drafting: source ledger
scope: Targeted primary-source review, not an exhaustive systematic survey or model reproduction. Read scopes are explicit.

sources.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
sources.supports: Hierarchy, conditional decoder factorization and latent marginal; no port performance inferred.

sources.title: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
sources.supports: KV memory-bandwidth motivation and multi-query attention; architectural change, not a cache-only patch.

sources.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
sources.supports: Paged KV allocation and sharing; no throughput figure transferred to this repository.

sources.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
sources.supports: Cross-request causal-prefix reuse; different scope from within-generation NCM prefix reuse.

sources.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
sources.supports: Acceptance/correction, distribution preservation and idealized cost assumptions.

sources.title: Accelerating Large Language Model Decoding with Speculative Sampling
sources.supports: Conditional block verification, hardware numerics and draft-cost trade-off.

sources.title: DistillSpec: Improving Speculative Decoding via Knowledge Distillation
sources.supports: Distribution alignment, on-policy draft data and task-dependent distillation objectives.

sources.title: SpecInfer: Accelerating Generative Large Language Model Serving with Tree-based Speculative Inference and Verification
sources.supports: Tree proposal and verification family; detailed tree algorithm not reproduced.

sources.title: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework with Multiple Decoding Heads
sources.supports: Multi-head proposals and backbone-training distinctions; no blanket exact-sampling claim.

sources.title: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
sources.supports: Feature-conditioned drafting; not implemented here.

sources.title: EAGLE-3: Scaling up Inference Acceleration of Large Language Models via Training-Time Test
sources.supports: Direct token prediction and multi-layer feature fusion; task/hardware-specific results not projected.

sources.title: LayerSkip: Enabling Early Exit Inference and Self-Speculative Decoding
sources.supports: Training-supported transformer-depth early exit; distinct from NCM concept-level budgets.

sources.title: Block Diffusion: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models
sources.supports: Block structure makes some diffusion caching possible; not proof for arbitrary non-causal states.

sources.title: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
sources.supports: Parallel drafting, target-feature KV injection and training masks; method review, not a reproduced speedup.

sources.title: DFlow: Enabling Verifier Information Flow in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
sources.supports: Rejected-suffix states as drafter hints; never committed target-cache history. Recent preprint.

sources.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
sources.supports: Distinguishes draft effort from acceptance leniency. Recent preprint; no claim of exactness for relaxed policies.

sources.title: Transformers assisted decoding documentation
sources.read_scope: Prompt lookup and self-speculative decoding sections
sources.supports: A training-free lookup baseline and the distinction between matching tokenizations and text re-encoding. Moving documentation, not a compatibility test.

sources.title: MLX Metal matmul dispatch
sources.supports: Float32 precision settings affect eligible Metal paths; no new precision experiment performed.

sources.title: MLX-LM speculative generation and cache helpers
sources.supports: Last-token prefill convention, cache-trimming requirements, strict positive output budget handling and equality-based verification. Not certification of p/q residual sampling.

sources.title: Blockwise Parallel Decoding for Deep Autoregressive Models
sources.supports: Greedy block proposals with longest-prefix validation; distinguishes exact and approximate operating modes.
